notes.notes:
[h1]🟢 CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS 🟢[/h1]
⭐ Completely overhauled map generation
⭐ Map is now seed-based – replay the same world anytime!
⭐ New room types – more variety and challenges
⭐ More rewards and combat encounters across the map
⭐ New wall and floor sprites – refreshed visuals
⭐ Updated interface with new UI sprites
⭐ New animations for Miguel and Manuela – bringing them to life!
⭐ New attack added for OBO, the Robot!
⭐ Rebalanced progression – smoother difficulty curve
⭐ Cutscene and tutorial added – learn the story and how to play
⭐ Both characters are now back on screen together, just like in earlier versions

[h1]🔴 BUG FIXES 🔴[/h1]
✅ All issues from the old map have been wiped out
✅ Boss attacks now behave correctly
✅ Fixed wall-clipping bug
✅ Settings menu now works properly
✅ And of course... many other bugs squashed that we forgot to list 😅

Join our [b]Discord[/b]: https://discord.gg/T2EqbBPeFu
